title: Swarm: orchestration-tier status (3 managers + 3 workers + Portainer)
description: Runs `nexus status swarm`. One table rolls up the 6 nodes from `docker node ls` (manager/leader vs reachable + worker), with overall health folded in from the Consul+Nomad+Portainer rollup (ClusterStatusService). The Swarm raft leader is read dynamically.

observe.what: 6-row table: 3 managers (one manager/leader, two manager/reachable) + 3 workers, all alive; leader line shows the swarm raft leader
JSON ClusterStatus: 6 members, overallHealth=green, Shards null

whatProves: SwarmAdapter.GetStatusAsync reuses ClusterStatusService for the overall rollup and enriches per-node role/status from docker node ls, identifying the single Swarm raft leader.
